name: SanDisk Corporation
blurb: SanDisk was spun off from Western Digital in February 2025 as an independent pure-play NAND flash memory company. It designs and manufactures NAND-based solid-state drives, flash storage chips, and consumer memory products. The spinoff allowed the market to re-rate the business on semiconductor multiples rather than hardware-manufacturer multiples, contributing to an extraordinary post-spinoff rally driven by the NAND supercycle.
recent: Since its February 2025 spinoff, SNDK surged over 2,400% through May 2026, reaching an all-time high above $1,189. Fiscal year 2025 revenue was approximately $7.4 billion, with gross margins expanding to ~36% from the low 20s in late 2024, aided by a shift toward high-margin QLC (quad-level cell) products. Analyst targets range from $975 (Wells Fargo, Equal Weight) to $1,250 (Bernstein SocGen, Outperform). A 247 Wall St. analysis in April 2026 flagged potential overvaluation of ~32% versus peers.
